name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 21, après le point a - Am 85
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ab) Emphasises that the Union’s food security and sovereignty are essential elements of its strategic autonomy and that the budget must support the Union’s agriculture and fisheries sectors, in particular family farms, young farmers, and fishermen, in order to enable them to produce food in a profitable, competitive, and sustainable manner; emphasises the essential role of the CAP in increasing productivity through technological progress, in ensuring a fair standard of living for farmers, and in guaranteeing food security;
